observed./mnt/d/ClaudeWork/rimmandrake/art_eval/r: A large pink-mauve fungus on a transparent background. A broad, uneven cap sags heavily to the right, with a wavy, folded rim and darker red speckles. Under the cap are dark purple-maroon gills. A thick, twisted pale-pink stalk splits into two or three fused trunks that flare into a knobbly cluster of bulbous lobes at the base. Glossy amber-orange droplets hang from several points along the rim, some long and teardrop-shaped. Painterly shading with a soft dark outline. The base sits on the bottom edge and nothing is cut off. There is no ground patch.

At max zoom (84 px/cell), the fungus is about 5 cells wide and about 4.5 cells tall, roughly 3.5–4 times the height of the vanilla human beside it. The cap overhangs a wide area. At 32 px/cell, the pink cap, the dripping rim and the knobbly base still read clearly as a giant mushroom next to a pawn and a small animal.

OURS.seen: Bespoke art matching the description; not vanilla or donor art.
